end.summary:
Practised representing 11–20 as one bundle of ten and loose ones.
Saanvi identified loose sticks when prompted.
They repeatedly counted the ten-bundle as one item in the total.
For 14, they gave four loose sticks once; teach-back was not passed.
The bundle-counting mix-up remained at the end; practice stopped when Saanvi said they were tired.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised showing a teen number as one group of ten and some loose ones. They identified the loose sticks when Asha pointed them out, but mixed up the bundle’s value with its count, so the total was not yet secure; this was not corrected by the end. At home, use 10 small objects tied together and a few single objects, and ask, “How many altogether?” while saying, “The bundle is ten, not one.”
